observed: Source audit for stock Strata v0.1.43.1 and stock OMP 18.10.1, from the v0.1.43 RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 IQ3_S 262K profile with pipeline windows 2, the display on the RTX 4090 and stock conversation parking: only Strata's Windows engine archive and source commit (a0116b2) change; OMP's binaries and source commit (5d0aaff), the IQ3_S pins, the llama.cpp archive and the Python lock are unchanged. The stock setup plan is unchanged (the stock v0.1.43.1 planner gives the identical plan): --max-context 262144 with KV streaming (--kv-resident 32768), INT8 KV, speculation 4 at minimum probability 0.5, prefill auto, both selected GPUs with the automatic layer split, --pipeline-windows 2 and the stock --conversation-cache-mib 8192, the same engine flags in the same order, no batch slots, calibration or prefill-chunk override, and the same host floors (86 GiB of RAM and 78 GiB available at start, 90 GiB of disk, driver 580). Stock setup changes MIN_ENGINE to 0.1.43.1, makes --calibrate with --model tune that installed model (#2036) and trusts a BUILD.json only beside an engine of the source's version (#2054); this profile neither calibrates nor builds locally, and requirements and the planner are unchanged. Multi-GPU stage-order inference was reviewed for v0.1.43.1: stock gpu_list, layer_split_value and ordered_gpus hash to the vendored fixture's digest, and every server and engine startup line it reads is unchanged; implementation 44f0f72 admits v0.1.43.1, and the host-free test that every multi-GPU profile pins a reviewed release failed before that change and passes after it. In this run G10 parsed the real v0.1.43.1 start complete, with both cards staged in their configured order. The hotfix's layer-split change for --batch with --batch-mtp (#2038) does not apply: this profile has no --batch. The v0.1.43.1 changes that reach this profile: the server reads a quoted </tool_call> in a message as text, not as the end of a call (#2026), and recovers a declared tool's JSON call written in a Markdown fence inside <tool_call> (#2037); a prompt chunk that needs more of the prompt loan than the auto chunk's region is lent it, or read in smaller pieces, instead of ending the engine (#2090); the start-up check of the n-gram table's direct reads only warns now instead of switching to memory-mapped reads, which could stall a long prompt's first chunk until the watchdog restarted the engine (#1984); parking a conversation reports progress to the watchdog (#2049), whose disk-read allowance now also measures on Windows and holds while the file tier was busy in the last 10 s; the prompt path's pageable host-to-device copies go through pinned bounce buffers (#1996); and a request warns when free VRAM is very low, with stall reports naming a draft wait (#2065). Windows NVIDIA decode defaults are unchanged: the adaptive overlap stays opt-in (v0.1.43.1 makes it opt-in on Linux too, #2010) and the new host-callback warm-up is Linux-only. Upstream reports answers byte-identical to v0.1.43 apart from a quoted </tool_call>. The host-free suite passes at d2fac61 with this profile's pinned OMP 18.10.1 binary and Strata v0.1.43.1 frontend. This profile has its own root and ledger; earlier tuples remain unchanged.
